Student Support & Mentorship

Who to turn to when settling into medical college.

Medical College

Medical CollegeMBBSMD/MSDepartments & HODsLibrary & FacilitiesLeadershipCommitteesStudent GuideStudent SupportTeaching HospitalContactDisclosures & Approvals

Start with your faculty mentor

The brochure describes a mentor–mentee framework with groups of 5–10 students and weekly meetings. Mentors support the transition into first year, keep in touch with parents or guardians and help students find academic or wellbeing support.

Help with study and language

Students who need more time with a subject can be guided towards remedial classes. The brochure also describes support with spoken English and adjustment to the academic environment.

Wellbeing and accessibility

Mentors can coordinate with the college’s psychiatry or psychology support when needed. Students with disabilities can raise physical, educational and accommodation needs through their mentor and the college office.

Staying in touch

The brochure describes attendance, assessment reports, hostel outpasses, circulars and feedback as features of a Student & Parent Smart Portal. Its live URL and availability are not yet confirmed, so access buttons remain demonstrations.
